{{Top|leg}}
A '''translatacomp''', also known as '''transcomp''', was an [[Electronic translator/Legends|electronic translator]] device that could automatically deduce translations between [[Language/Legends|languages]].

==History==
During an encounter with a [[Unidentified googly-eyed species|google-eyed species]], an [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance]] [[Corvette/Legends|corvette's]] translatacomp failed to translate their language.<ref name="Night">{{WEGCite|story=The Night Has a Thousand Eyes|book=Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game (first edition)}}</ref>

While on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Shiva IV]], [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] was forced to learn the [[Calian language|Calian]] [[Language/Legends|language]] when it was not recognized by her translatacomp. She estimated it would take a while to sort things out enough for her to be able to communicate with [[Calian]]s.<ref name="SW53">[[Star Wars (1977) 53|''Star Wars'' (1977) 53]]</ref>
